mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.department_id AS departmentId FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = la.login_id AND u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id WHERE la.login_code = #{loginCode} AND la.tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' AND g.use_at = 'Y' AND i.item_code = #{code} AND i.use_at = 'Y' )

SELECT h.purchase_request_id AS purchaseRequestId, h.tenant_id AS tenantId, h.request_no AS requestNo, h.request_dt AS requestDt, h.requester_id AS requesterId, ru.user_nm AS requesterName, h.request_dept_id AS requestDeptId, d.department_nm AS requestDeptName, h.status AS status, h.total_amt AS totalAmt, h.remark AS remark, h.created_by AS createdBy, cu.user_nm AS createdByName, to_char(h.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, h.updated_by AS updatedBy, uu.user_nm AS updatedByName, to_char(h.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM tb_purchase_request_hd h LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.user_id = h.requester_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = h.request_dept_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account cla ON cla.login_code = h.created_by AND cla.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.login_id = cla.login_id AND cu.tenant_id = cla.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account ula ON ula.login_code = h.updated_by AND ula.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user uu ON uu.login_id = ula.login_id AND uu.tenant_id = ula.tenant_id WHERE h.purchase_request_id = #{purchaseRequestId} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y'

SELECT h.purchase_request_id AS purchaseRequestId, h.tenant_id AS tenantId, h.status AS status FROM tb_purchase_request_hd h WHERE h.purchase_request_id = #{purchaseRequestId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' FOR UPDATE OF h

SELECT d.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, d.purchase_request_id AS purchaseRequestId, d.line_no AS lineNo, d.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, d.request_qty AS requestQty, d.request_delivery_dt AS requestDeliveryDt, d.use_type AS useType, ci.item_nm AS useTypeName, d.request_remark AS requestRemark, d.confirm_qty AS confirmQty FROM tb_purchase_request_dt d LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group cg ON cg.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND cg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item ci ON ci.group_id = cg.common_code_group_id AND ci.item_code = d.use_type WHERE d.purchase_request_id = #{purchaseRequestId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY d.line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_purchase_request_hd SET request_dt = CAST(#{requestDt} AS date), remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_request_id = #{purchaseRequestId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_purchase_request_dt SET line_no = #{lineNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, material_id = #{materialId}, request_qty = #{requestQty}, request_delivery_dt = CAST(#{requestDeliveryDt} AS date), use_type = #{useType}, request_remark = #{requestRemark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_request_detail_id = #{purchaseRequestDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND purchase_request_id = #{purchaseRequestId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
UPDATE tb_purchase_request_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_request_id = #{purchaseRequestId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND use_at = 'Y'
